verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents its own API reference, including the HTTP API, the Pixel API, and management APIs for transformations, audit logs and usage metrics. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable try-it examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. The Event Playground sends sample events, but it is a separate testing app, not part of the API reference, so it gets no credit here. Missing for 10: interactive try-it-out console in the API reference, runnable code examples, published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
